notes.title: Official release date set!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/a5db266dfb7b174a2be27c0e239db5e78e4650f3.png[/img]

Hello naysayers! 
Exciting news – [b]the full version of Negative Nancy is coming to Steam on October 14th![/b]

It’s been a long journey but it’s finally almost here. Soon you’ll be saying ‘No!’ to all kinds of people in all kinds of situations. Guide Nancy through a branching storyline across 4 episodes in this ‘choose your ‘No!’ adventure’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/ed99a165b22cfdbd480f3e192ab38f95755483e4.png[/img]

In the meantime why not try our new demo? It gives you a little taste of the episode ‘[i]A Day To Forget[/i]’. 
What will you say ‘No!’ to?

[b]Before you go…[/b]
We’re a small team that have been working long and hard to bring Negative Nancy to life, and if you’d like to support us it would really help us out if you considered [b]Wishlisting[/b] Negative Nancy here on Steam. The more wishlists we get the people Steam will show the game to, and we would really appreciate your help in getting the word out.

Thanks,
FEED out.
